rv.q: Leaning more toward this kind of actual history and away from the story of the two couples would have given “Dirty Books” more of the heft that the subject deserves, because this is not just history.
It’s also, unfortunately, a bit of a snooze.

cn.t: Critics find this audience-interactive show about book banning more educational than provocative, with a bland plot that could use more edge, though the unconventional presentation earns modest praise.
